description: This Java class defines a PreferenceFragment for managing panic-related settings in an Android app, including selecting panic apps, hiding the app, resetting repositories, and uninstalling apps.

classes.name: PanicPreferencesFragment
classes.description: An Android PreferenceFragment for configuring panic-related settings, including selecting panic apps, hiding the app, resetting repositories, and managing uninstall list.

methods.name: onCreatePreferences
methods.description: Initializes preferences UI, sets up listeners, and manages panic app selection.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Registers preference change listener and shows uninstall list if applicable.

methods.name: showWipeList
methods.description: Displays list of apps to uninstall during panic.

methods.name: onSharedPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Handles preference changes, such as showing confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: showPanicApp
methods.description: Populates the panic app selection list and updates UI based on selected app.

methods.name: showOptInDialog
methods.description: Displays dialog for user to opt-in to panic app.

methods.name: getCallingPackageName
methods.description: Retrieves the package name of the calling activity.

methods.name: showHideConfirmationDialog
methods.description: Shows confirmation dialog when enabling hiding feature.
